latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of afrexai-medical-billing skill:

- Provides end-to-end analysis of medical billing workflows, denial management, payer contracts, coding, compliance, and patient collections.
- Includes specialty-specific guidance on CPT/ICD-10 coding accuracy and modifier usage.
- Benchmarks practice KPIs and identifies revenue leaks with actionable recommendations.
- Features payer contract comparison tools and underpayment detection.
- Covers compliance checklists (OIG, Stark Law, No Surprises Act) and internal audit frameworks.
- Supports customizable queries for denial analysis, appeal letters, and fee schedule comparisons.
